learning_outcomes.text: Define AGI and related terms and explain why they are contested
Describe the gap between today's narrow AI and general intelligence
Explain the main drivers of AI progress and their limits
Interpret capability benchmarks critically and cautiously
Reason about uncertain long-range scenarios without overclaiming
Discuss safety, alignment and governance as genuine open questions

integrative_case: A discussion group wants an honest briefing on the future of AI and AGI: clarify the terms, explain how progress is driven and measured, lay out why expert timelines disagree, and frame benefits, risks and safety as open questions rather than settled predictions.
